`enum UniformLayout`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UniformLayout.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/UniformLayout.java)

How a translated program declares its uniforms, in one std140 block or one by one.

## Description

A backend chooses it when it creates its [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/).
In both layouts, the [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/) keeps the values in the same [`UniformBlock`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/); only the way the backend sends them changes.

Backend note: the OpenGL backends use `LOOSE`, Vulkan uses `BLOCK`.

## Learn more

- [Pick a uniform layout](/build/shader-translation/#pick-a-uniform-layout)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`BLOCK`](#UniformLayout-value-BLOCK) | Declares every uniform in one std140 block; the backend packs it with [`UniformBlock.pack`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/#UniformBlock-method-pack) and sends the whole buffer. |
| [`LOOSE`](#UniformLayout-value-LOOSE) | Declares each uniform on its own; the backend sends each changed member with [`UniformBlock.upload`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/#UniformBlock-method-upload). |

## Value details

<a id="UniformLayout-value-BLOCK"></a>

### BLOCK

`BLOCK` 

Declares every uniform in one std140 block; the backend packs it with [`UniformBlock.pack`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/#UniformBlock-method-pack) and sends the whole buffer.
It needs a dialect with uniform blocks.

<a id="UniformLayout-value-LOOSE"></a>

### LOOSE

`LOOSE` 

Declares each uniform on its own; the backend sends each changed member with [`UniformBlock.upload`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/#UniformBlock-method-upload).
It works in every dialect.
